Workflow

How Flavor works

Two loops. The outer one is how an agent consumes the system through the MCP; the inner one is how the system itself changes and reaches every agent without anyone rewriting a manual. Both end in the same place: a guard that fails loudly.

A · An agent, via MCP

Read left to right. Blue is a tool call; the gate loops back to Build until it is green; the review loop runs as often as a human wants.

  1. 1
    Connect

    Agent registers the server

    claude mcp add --transport http flavor-ds https://flavor-ds.vercel.app/api/mcp
  2. 2
    Recall memory

    Rules first — always. Then the chunks ranked for the task, budgeted; omitted ids listed.

    flavor_recall({ task })
  3. 3
    Fetch specifics

    Only what the task still needs.

    flavor_recall({ ids }) · flavor_get_component · flavor_find_icon · flavor_get_theme · flavor_get_contrast_pairs
  4. 4
    Adapt to the stack

    Stack-aware install steps; tokens as CSS, DTCG, Swift or Kotlin.

    flavor_adapt_project · flavor_get_tokens
  5. 5
    Build

    Semantic tokens only · nine <html> attributes · documented component markup · behaviors.js for keyboard.

  6. 6
    Verify

    The guards falsify the work. Red → back to Build.

    npm test
  7. 7
    Human review

    Reviewer pins selector-scoped, token-named tweaks on Canvas; the agent applies them.

    flavor_canvas_feedback
  8. 8
    Ship

    Themed across all 1,152 colour combos × radius × density × type × direction.

gate — red returns to Buildloop — repeats with the reviewerend

B · How the system updates itself

A change is made once, at the source; every artefact — CSS, DTCG, native, Figma, the docs, and the agent index — is regenerated, gated, and published together. Agents get the update on their next recall.

  1. 1
    Proposal

    Rule of three: a third real use case, or it stays product-local. Issue/PR against GOVERNANCE.md.

  2. 2
    Edit the source

    One place per concern: packages/tokens/build.mjs (ramps, semantic map, axes) · packages/ui/src (components.css, components.tsx, behaviors.js) · componentDocs.ts / productNav.ts (docs = index).

  3. 3
    Generate

    flavor.css · tokens.json (DTCG) · contrast.json (34,560 pairings) · meta.json · figma.json · i18n · FlavorTokens.swift/.kt · icons sprite · agent index (rules.md, index.json, llms.txt)

    npm run build:tokens · build:icons
  4. 4
    Guards

    test-tokens (golden + contrast floors) · wcag-qa · lint:tokens · check-templates · check-polish · test-native (Swift typecheck) · test-behaviors · check-canvas-utilities · test-recall · adoption --check

    npm test
  5. 5
    Version + deprecate

    Semver with a written definition of breaking; deprecations alias for one minor, removed next major; CHANGELOG entry.

    GOVERNANCE.md
  6. 6
    Publish

    Docs site (82 pages, /agent/*, /llms.txt) · @flavor-ds/tokens · @flavor-ds/ui · @flavor-ds/mcp · Figma variables

    npm run ci · flavor_figma_sync
  7. 7
    Agents see it

    Next flavor_recall reads the new index — no hand-written summary to update.

  8. 8
    Feedback loop

    Canvas comments (.canvas/feedback.json) and adoption metrics feed the next proposal.

gate — red blocks the releaseloop — feeds the next proposalend

Where the two loops touch

  • Index — B step 3 writes /agent/index.json; A step 2 reads it. Rebuilt on every build:tokens, never hand-edited.
  • Guards — the same npm test gates a release (B 4) and an agent's generated UI (A 6).
  • Canvas — a reviewer's pins are applied by the agent (A 7) and, when they ask for a token change, become a proposal (B 1) — never a hardcoded value.
  • Adoption — scripts/adoption.mjs measures token coverage, hardcoded values, component/icon/behaviour usage; the baseline may only rise.

The rules it follows

Priority 0 in the memory index: returned first on every recall, and each one names the guard that enforces it. Source of truth: /agent/rules.md.

  1. Semantic tokens only. Components, templates and product code reference --surface-*, --text-*, --border-*, --accent-*, --success|warning|danger|info-*, --space-N, --radius-control|field|container|media|round, --font-*, --duration-N, --ease-*. Never a primitive (--flavor-*, --ramp-*) and never a literal colour or px for a themable property. lint:tokens, check-templates, adoption
  2. Contrast is computed, never asserted. Every text/background pairing in the semantic tier already clears WCAG AA (or AAA under data-contrast="aaa"); use pairings as designed — --text-primary on --surface-*, --accent-fg on --accent-bg, --{status}-text on --{status}-bg. Do not invent a pairing. wcag-qa: 34,560 pairings, +0.05 safety margin
  3. Theme is nine attributes on <html> , nothing else: data-hue data-sat data-mode data-contrast data-bg data-radius data-density data-font dir. Set them; do not fork stylesheets. Defaults: hue=brand sat=regular mode=light contrast=aa bg=primary radius=rounded density=regular font=expressive dir=ltr.
  4. Radius follows the axis. --radius-control (buttons, chips, tabs), --radius-field (inputs), --radius-container (cards, dialogs), --radius-media (imagery). Anything that must stay a circle uses --radius-round. Numeric --radius-1..6 do not re-resolve and are not for product code.
  5. Logical properties only (inline-start, block-end, padding-inline) so dir="rtl" flips layout for free. Icons that carry direction take data-directional.
  6. Icons come from the sprite. <svg class="fds-icon" data-icon><use href="/icons/sprite.svg#hi-NAME-outline"></use></svg> (or <Icon name>). Never draw a glyph by hand; outline is the default state, solid marks active. Find names with flavor_find_icon.
  7. Motion on tokens. transition-property names exact properties (never all); durations are var(--duration-N) so reduced-motion can zero them; will-change only for observed stutter. Press feedback is scale(var(--press-scale)) = 0.96.
  8. Targets have a floor. Interactive elements are ≥ 40×40 (dense desktop) / 44×44 (touch); density never takes a target below it. Small controls extend the target with the ::after technique or data-hit.
  9. Behaviour comes with the component. Menu, Tabs, Dialog, Listbox and Tooltip get their keyboard/focus contracts from behaviors.js (data-fds-*); do not reimplement key handling. test-behaviors: 40 contracts
  10. Rule of three before promoting anything into the shared system; one-offs stay product-local. Deprecations alias for one minor and are removed in the next major. GOVERNANCE.md
  11. Media background : --surface-page is transparent; text placed directly on the photo binds text-on-media; text in opaque panes keeps text-primary.
  12. Verify, don't assume. After generating UI, run the guards (npm test) and, for reviewed work, read flavor_canvas_feedback. A green check that was never falsified is not evidence.
